vision.name: Bojack's Cosmic Bomber
vision.text:
[Attack] 2: Energy attack.
Unmodifiable. If Team Bojack is in play, Unstoppable.
DAMAGE: 6 life cards.
HIT: Raise your anger 2 or search your discard pile or Banished Zone for an [Trait:Alien] Ally and Rejuvenate it.
(Banish after use.)
